mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate being at a historically low level (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to compressed discount rates and elevated equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of all time periods, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25%, it signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.25% and industrial production exceeds 95, the combination signals robust economic conditions that support positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.25% AND INDPRO > 95, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (CPIAUCSL > 225 and UNRATE > 7.0%), the economy experiences inflationary pressures and labor market tightness that support continued equity gains, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225 AND UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 95, it indicates robust economic activity and strong corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 95, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it signals a weak labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 700 and residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 400,000, it indicates a strong housing market and robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 700 AND RSAFS > 400000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The housing starts (HOUST) being at a high level (as a persistent feature of the current housing market) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of all time periods, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
